scope: New 5 Hz EAS upright near-trim candidate; no platform flight or high-maneuver claim.
sign_convention: A positive tends to positive p; E negative tends to positive q; R positive tends to negative yaw moment. Beta correction is +K*(beta_ref-beta), a near-trim kinematic inference requiring plant verification.

candidate_basis.angle_and_rate_gains: historical initial candidate values; new 5 Hz validation required
candidate_basis.filter_tau_sec: initial 0.1 retained explicitly; not established at 5 Hz
candidate_basis.integration: only measured body rates, beta and EAS errors; no height integrator
